dispositions.identity_reason: The proposed operator injectivity is stronger than its dimension consequence q_p<=q_(p-1), and is an ordinary-tree, selected-leaf, strict-lower-region assertion. The beta entries concern coefficient signs on a governed model; the r23 entries concern literal tagged relations and Hall neighborhoods. The T22 positive pointwise dimension gap independently kills this operator, but does not identify these different mechanisms.

The inequality compares the w-weighted and unweighted occupancy means at the same rank p. CT_x compares the weighted mean at p with the unweighted mean at the first descent x, a different inequality. The aggregate is a scalar count difference, and the registered two-for-one Hall claim has different edges and capacities. The order-14 witness violates only the proposed same-rank inequality among these comparisons.

dispositions.identity_reason: Put r=p-1. Then |T|=2p+4 is |T|=2r+6, and x+2<=p is x<r. The proposed implication x<r => tau>=7 is the contrapositive of tau<=6 => x>=r on trees. The existing D6 record explicitly includes that x-form and certifies the same order-24 tree with tau=6, x=8, r=9, Delta_8=-78. Its stronger strict-positive wording is not logically equivalent to x>=r when an earlier difference is zero; use only the exact negative witness and the intended x-bound when aliasing.
